title: Alignment Plan Bundle Points on Out-of-Area Replacement Reimbursements
content:
An Alignment Services & Plans plan held on the vehicle adds bundle points to the reimbursement of an out-of-area tire replacement under Road Hazard Protection.

**Out-of-area bundle points.** A vehicle with a Crestline alignment plan in status active that was sold on the certificate's own purchase ticket adds 4 points to the out-of-area coverage percentage; a vehicle with an active Crestline alignment plan sold on a different ticket adds 2 points; a vehicle with no active alignment plan adds no out-of-area bundle points.

| Active alignment plan on the vehicle | Sold on | Points |
|---|---|---|
| yes | the certificate's own purchase ticket | 4 |
| yes | a different ticket | 2 |
| no | — | 0 |
